findings.pdf_says: Boolean literals in the VALUE clause of a bit group item shall not exceed the size of the group item.
findings.markdown_says: Boolean literals in theVALUE clause of a bit group item shall not exceed the size of the group item.
findings.why_it_matters: Cosmetic only: a reader or a search for the phrase "the VALUE clause" misses this sentence; no rule changes.
findings.note: Syntax rule 6 of 13.16.61.2 (VALUE clause): the space between 'the' and 'VALUE' is lost ('theVALUE'); wording otherwise intact, meaning unchanged.
